# Paperlike

> Paperlike creates iPad screen protectors and accessories that deliver a paper-like writing and drawing experience for digital creators, students, and professionals.

Paperlike specializes in premium iPad accessories designed to enhance the tactile experience of digital creation. Their flagship product, the Paperlike 3 screen protector with Nanodots technology, works seamlessly with Apple Pencil and popular creative apps like Procreate, GoodNotes, and Notability.
